golden_text_response: No, the recreational area does not comply with 10A NCAC 13F .0305 because subsection (b)(4) requires a required living room and recreational area to have windows with views to the outside, and this fully interior area has no windows of any kind, even though its 400 square feet meets the subsection (b)(3) minimum of 16 square feet per resident for a building with a licensed capacity of 16 or more.
